description: Source code for Redis-based grain storage provider in Orleans, implementing IGrainStorage and ILifecycleParticipant, with methods for initializing, reading, writing, and clearing grain state using Redis via StackExchange.Redis library.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements Redis-based grain storage for Orleans, managing lifecycle, connection, read/write/clear operations, and Redis scripting for concurrency control.

methods.name: RedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing RedisGrainStorage with dependencies and options.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers lifecycle participation in silo startup/shutdown.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes Redis connection and database, measures elapsed time, handles exceptions.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state from Redis, deserializes data, manages ETag.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes grain state to Redis using Lua script for concurrency control.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or resets grain state in Redis, with concurrency safeguards.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and disposes Redis connection on shutdown.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Uses activator provider to create new instances of grain state.

methods.name: DefaultGetStorageKey
methods.description: Generates Redis key based on service ID, grain ID, and grain type.
